source_text:
Priya Shah
Embedded Software Engineer
Skills
Python - Working
C - Working
Git - Working
Experience
Delta Automation | Embedded Software Engineer | Jul 2022 | Present
Education
ABC University | B.E. | Electrical Engineering | 2022
Certifications
Linux Foundation Certified IT Associate (2023) - Linux Foundation

Interviewer: What have you built that is relevant to this role?
Candidate: I mainly supported test execution and wrote small Python scripts for log parsing.
Interviewer: Have you designed RTL?
Candidate: I have not designed production RTL yet, but I studied Verilog in college.
Interviewer: Give an example of impact.
Candidate: I helped the team save two hours each week by automating a report.

Role: Embedded Systems Engineer
Summary: Build and validate embedded control firmware and digital logic for industrial products.
Required Skills
- C/C++ or Python
- Verilog or SystemVerilog / RTL fundamentals
- Debugging and test-driven engineering
- Linux and Git
Preferred Skills
- MATLAB or LTspice
- CI/CD and observability tooling
Responsibilities
- Design and validate digital control logic.
- Diagnose system failures using structured experiments.
- Collaborate with firmware, hardware, and test engineers.
- Document trade-offs and verification evidence.
Constraints
- Must contribute independently within the first 90 days.
- Role requires evidence of hands-on design depth.
